blocks.prompt: 5. The radius of a sphere is measured as \(100 \pm 0.5\) cm and the volume is calculated from this measurement. Estimate the percentage error in the volume calculation.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh calculated quantity ke percentage error ka sawal hai, Example 29 jaisa.
Diya kya hai? Radius \(r = 100\) cm aur ghalti \(dr = \pm 0.5\) cm.
Find kya karna hai? Sphere ke volume \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}\) mein percentage error, \(\left|\frac{dV}{V}\right| \times 100\).
Plan: pehle radius ka percentage error, phir \(\frac{dV}{V} = 3\frac{dr}{r}\) wala rishta.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(r = 100\) cm, \(dr = \pm 0.5\) cm.
Maloom karna: \(\left|\frac{dV}{V}\right| \times 100\).
Tareeqa: \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}\) ka differential, phir \(V\) se divide (Example 29 ki tarah).

Radius ka percentage error
\[\left|\dfrac{dr}{r}\right| \times 100 = \dfrac{0.5}{100} \times 100\]
\[= 0.5\% \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: percentage error = ghalti / napi hui value \(\times\) 100.

Volume ka differential
\[V = \tfrac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}\]
\[dV = 4\pi r^{2}\,dr \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{4}{3}\pi\) constant hai; \(r^{3}\) ka derivative \(3r^{2}\), aur \(\frac{4}{3} \times 3 = 4\).

\(V\) se divide karein
\[\left|\dfrac{dV}{V}\right| \times 100 = \left|\dfrac{4\pi r^{2}\,dr}{\frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}}\right| \times 100\]
\[= 3 \times \left|\dfrac{dr}{r}\right| \times 100\]
(1) se:
\[= 3 \times 0.5\% = 1.5\%\]
Kyun: \(4\pi\) cancel, \(\frac{r^{2}}{r^{3}} = \frac{1}{r}\), aur \(\frac{1}{4/3} = \frac{3}{4}\) se 3 bacha. Power 3 thi, to percentage error 3 guna.
Dhyan dein: \(dV\) ko percentage samajh lena ghalat hai; percentage ke liye \(V\) se divide karna zaroori hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\left(\dfrac{100.5}{100}\right)^{3} - 1 = 0.015075\]
Yani 1.5075%, jo 1.5% ke bohat qareeb hai.
